newsitem.title: CANADA: Noranda resumes Heath Steele operations.
newsitem.headline: Noranda resumes Heath Steele operations.

text.p: Noranda Inc said on Monday it has resumed operations at its Heath Steele mines in New Brunswick following a two-week shutdown.
The mine was shut down to carry out an independent safety assessment of its operations after two accidents within one month at the mine.
On November 4, one man was killed and another severely injured after a blast in the mine. And on November 29, four miners were hospitalized after coming into contact with gases in the mine.
"The review is now complete," George Greer said in a statement. Greer, a former inspector of mines for the province of New Brunswick, conducted the review.
He said he will finalize the report within the next few days. A news conference is expected later this week to discuss the details of the report.
The mine, near Miramichi, New Brunswick, produces 2,700 tonnes of ore a day.
